overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong scholarly presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a total follower base of 3,580. His posts focus heavily on computational social science, disinformation research, tool updates, and academic recruitment, achieving high relative engagement especially on Bluesky and LinkedIn.

contentThemes.description: Sharing newly published papers, grants, and conference presentations regarding coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Updates on software tools like CooRnet v2.0 for detecting coordinated link sharing.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's high amplification (repost) rate by posting actionable call-to-actions and interactive discussion prompts.
Cross-promote open-source software tools (like CooRnet) with links and media attachments on LinkedIn to tap into its larger audience base.
Increase posting frequency on Mastodon to build deeper community interactions around methodological discussions.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest engagement rate overall (averaging ~6.1%), driven by strong repost activity on publication announcements and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a focused academic niche with steady engagement around software releases and methodological discussions, though total reach remains modest.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest single follower base (1,850 followers) generating high raw engagement (likes and comments) particularly on grant announcements and hiring posts.
